name: Shiori
message: "...Seeing it again from down here..."

name: Shiori
message: "I can't believe I actually jumped..."

name: Shiori
message: "It's true I was desperate to get my memories back, but that was only part of it. I probably got carried away after finally finding someone I could talk to."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, that reminds me. I was really surprised when you took a photo."

name: Shiori
message: "Thinking back on it, it was a pretty gruesome way to die, and yet you didn't even bat an eye. I remember thinking, 'Wow, my buddy's tough!'"

name: Shiori
message: "This might not have been a memorable place back when I was alive, but to the 'me' right now, it's irreplaceable."

name: Shiori
message: "The place that marked the very first entry in the Death Diary, where you and I made our first memory together."

name: Shiori
message: "Did that sound a bit too heavy? Ehehe."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah, that's right. I just remembered why I recognized this place."

name: Shiori
message: "This used to be part of our walking route."

name: Shiori
message: "I used to go on walks with my sister. We'd avoid the main roads with lots of traffic and go for safer, quieter paths like this."

name: Shiori
message: "I'd hold her tiny hand and walk slowly, matching her pace. Those were precious moments..."

name: Shiori
message: "But the me back then... might've thought it was kind of a hassle. I'm sure my sister did too."

name: Shiori
message: "Mom would shoo us outside and tell us to go play. We'd grumble to each other about what to do, whether to go to the park or just wander around. Things like that."

name: Shiori
message: "Dad knew my sister wasn't the athletic type, but he couldn't really stand up to Mom..."

name: Shiori
message: "Ah... I know it sounds like I'm complaining about my parents, but I really do love them."

name: Shiori
message: "Mom could be a little inflexible at times, but she was very earnest and hardworking. She always gave it her all and never cut corners with the housework."

name: Shiori
message: "Dad could be a little unassertive, but he was kind and playful. On his days off, he'd always spend time with us as a family."

name: Shiori
message: "I really love them..."

name: Shiori
message: "Okay, why am I reminiscing about my family in front of someone else's apartment?"

name: Shiori
message: "If anything, I should at least do it in front of my own apartment. This isn't making any sense... Every time I look up at this building, all I remember is falling from it..."

name: Shiori
message: "More importantly... this is Kirishiki Nagisa-san's suicide—no, murder site."

name: Shiori
message: "She died before I did... and yet, I used to pass by here all the time without knowing any of it."

name: Shiori
message: "I didn't even know someone had died here. Maybe that's just how it is. Or was I just too indifferent?"

name: Shiori
message: "...We should at least pay our respects. Even if it *is* a bit late."
(Pay respects)

name: Shiori
message: "Okay, that should do. Now then, shall we go?"
